color.note: Two fixed brand colours (slate-blue, sage-teal) are identical in both themes. Everything else is a theme token. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.

tokens.name: slate-blue
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, never altered. Light theme: text-safe on bg (5.1:1) and surface (5.5:1), so it is the headline highlight and link colour. Dark theme: fills, shapes and text 24px+ only (3.2:1 on bg).

tokens.name: sage-teal
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, never altered. Dark theme: text-safe on bg (7.1:1) and surface (6.3:1), so it is the highlight and link colour. Light theme: fills, shapes, lines and icons only, never text (2.3:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Post background. Light: Mist, a cool off-white. Dark: Deep Slate, the brand blue's hue at 10% lightness (not the old royal navy).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and quote boxes placed on bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text, on bg and surface. Light 15.2:1 on bg; dark 16.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Body copy and subheads, on bg and surface. Light 8.2:1; dark 9.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, handle, URL line, series labels, on bg and surface. Light 4.5:1 on bg; dark 5.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole way to separate meaning.

tokens.name: motif
tokens.usage: The oversized, cropped VS mark and the line-and-node mesh drawn faintly behind content. Sits just off bg in each theme.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The 1–3 highlighted words in a headline, and small accent text. Slate blue in light, sage teal in dark: each is the brand colour that passes contrast on that theme's bg.

tokens.name: wash-blue
tokens.usage: Tinted panels and chips. Ink and body text read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: wash-teal
tokens.usage: Tinted panels and chips, the teal variant. Ink and body text read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a slate-blue fill (5.5:1).

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on a sage-teal fill (6.6:1 light, 7.1:1 dark). Never white on teal (2.5:1).

gradient.note: The brand gradient: the logo's own colours, start to end.

tokens.name: brand-gradient
tokens.usage: Logo, graphic bars, shapes and the mark. As TEXT only in the dark theme (both ends pass 3:1 at 24px+). In the light theme use highlight (slate-blue) for words instead.

groups.name: Post type (sizes at 1080 × 1350)
groups.note: Inter only, the website's face. Sizes are for the full-size 4:5 post; overlays render them, the image model never does.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One short statement (up to 5 words) on Brand world posts.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The main headline on most posts, up to 8 words, sentence case.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Client words on Proof posts, verbatim.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: What we check before every release
styles.usage: One supporting line under the headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Milestone payments: at kickoff, at key phases, at delivery.
styles.usage: Short text blocks and quote attribution.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Series name and episode, above the headline, in highlight.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Website or handle line at the bottom, in muted.

spacing.note: At full post size (1080 × 1350). Scale proportionally for previews.

tokens.name: safe-x
tokens.usage: Clear edge left and right. Also covers Instagram's 3:4 grid crop (about 34px a side).

tokens.name: safe-y
tokens.usage: Clear edge top and bottom, so logo and text survive a centred 1:1 crop (135px a side).

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Label to headline; caption line gaps.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Headline to subhead; inside panels.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Between text block and image or panel.

tokens.name: logo-height
tokens.usage: Height of the full lockup, top-left at safe-x / safe-y (about 184px wide).

radius.note: Soft and calm, like the website's rounded panels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, quote boxes and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills.
